name: Contract Tracker

cards.name: Hợp Đồng Hết Hạn Trong 30 Ngày

native.query: SELECT c.id::text as contract_number, v.name as title, c.end_date, c.value as total_value FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.procurement_contracts c LEFT JOIN {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.procurement_vendors v ON v.id = c.vendor_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY c.end_date
